name: @offertrail/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Offertrail (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle journeys --output src/.bundled/journeys.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle journeys --output src/.bundled/journeys.json && redocly bundle offers --output src/.bundled/offers.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle offers --output src/.bundled/offers.json && redocly bundle consents --output src/.bundled/consents.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle consents --output src/.bundled/consents.json && redocly bundle fulfilments --output src/.bundled/fulfilments.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle fulfilments --output src/.bundled/fulfilments.json && redocly bundle incidents --output src/.bundled/incidents.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle incidents --output src/.bundled/incidents.json && redocly bundle reporting --output src/.bundled/reporting.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle reporting --output src/.bundled/reporting.json
